title: Competitor
description: One competing location. Content fields are transient by Google Maps ToS: only `place_id` and the derived judgment fields may be persisted past a run. See docs/data-sources.md.

place_id.description: Storable indefinitely under Google Maps ToS.

persistable.description: Marks whether this record has had its transient content stripped for storage.

detour_ratio.description: drive distance / straight-line distance. Above ~1.6 means a barrier (river, highway, one-way grid) sits between here and the target, which is the whole reason drive time replaces radius.

overrode_prior.description: True when the model disagreed with the vertical config prior.

chain_group.description: Brand key when several locations share an operator. Used to damp entrenchment so a 6-store chain is not counted as 6 independent competitors.

earliest_review_at.description: Oldest publishTime among the <=5 reviews the API returns. A weak LOWER BOUND on business age and nothing more.

weight.description: s * e * a. Contribution to the Supply Index.
